backend_selection: least-busy operational non-simulator accessible backend meeting circuit width; one backend preferred
shot_choice_rule: choose the smallest shot level with mean relative Frobenius error <= 0.15, maximum absolute error <= 0.20, and repeat relative Frobenius discrepancy <= 0.15; otherwise unresolved
temporal_interpretation: observation block 2 begins only after block 1 completes and a fresh context snapshot is captured; absent a calibration-boundary separation, this estimates repeated-execution rather than longitudinal variability
stop_if: estimated campaign cost exceeds approved cap
